title: Intraline emphasis follow-ups (BPR-0321, BPR-0322)
reference_disclaimer: Two unrelated decisions in one sitting. The first is an ordinary accept or reject: the selected-row fix you asked for. The rest are three alternatives to a single question about one profile — pick exactly one, and the others are recorded as not chosen rather than defective. The second decision exists because the batch that chose the current palette measured strength and text contrast but never measured colour vision, and in high-contrast dark that omission left added and removed indistinguishable to a deuteranope. Captures are offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1; native artwork, issue closure, RFC closeout, and release readiness are outside this batch.

selection_groups.title: Which high-contrast dark pair should ship?

subjects.display_name: A selected row's mark now wears the row's own wash
subjects.description: You reported that a blue selected row still got a red or green patch stamped inside it. The mark now takes the same selection wash the row takes, so it stays a deeper shade of whatever the row is wearing. Look at the top row in each capture: it is the selected one, and its changed digits should now read as part of that band rather than as a foreign colour sitting on it. The rows below it are unselected and must still show exactly the salmon and green you accepted.
acceptance_criteria: On the selected row, the changed characters read as part of the selection band
The changed characters are still findable on the selected row
Unselected rows are unchanged from the palette you accepted
The effect holds in all four appearance profiles
known_concerns: Offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1; not native macOS artwork.

The moved-row half of your report is not included because it cannot occur: intraline edits exist only for similar pairs, which come only from replacement segments, and move detection marks only left-only and right-only segments. A moved row cannot carry a mark today.
Between 70 and 79 percent of each mark's separation survives the wash, measured, and text on the washed mark stays above the emphasis floor in every profile.

audit_verdict.note: dev 186/186 and core-only 86/86 at this commit, format and strict clang-tidy clean. A test asserts the washed mark and fails when the wash is removed.

subjects.display_name: Keep the colours you already picked

Only the high-contrast dark profile differs between these three; the other profiles are identical in all of them and are included so you can confirm nothing else moved.

Both marks are visible against their row fills
The code on the marks is comfortable to read

known_concerns: Nothing changes anywhere; every profile stays exactly as accepted.
The colour-vision gap stays open and stays recorded as a known defect.
